utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Hello dear, how was your day?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Hi Grandma! My day was pretty good, just a bit busy with schoolwork.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh my, it sounds like you're really overwhelmed. Can I help with anything?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma! I think I can manage, but I appreciate the offer.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, I see! Thank you for explaining that to me. I'm glad you're okay.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Is there anything else you'd like to share about your day?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Well, I did have a bit of a rough start this morning, but things got better later on.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, I see. How are things going with him?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Things are going pretty well with him. We had a nice chat yesterday.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, that's good to hear. Are you planning anything fun together?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Yeah, we're thinking of going to the new art exhibit this weekend. It should be fun!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Yes, you did it! I'm proud of you.
